method: Trim visible fat from the back-bacon rashers and weigh the listed portion raw before cooking.
Wash the vegetables. Chop onion and peppers where listed; slice tomato where listed and keep raw meat preparation separate.

Use half the measured olive oil in a frying pan. Cut the bacon into bite-size pieces. Cook the lean back bacon thoroughly, turning regularly. Check the thickest piece is steaming hot through the centre. A clean probe should read 70°C for 2 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Heat the remaining half of the measured olive oil in the frying pan. Add the tomato, spinach; cook until softened, with spinach wilted and excess liquid evaporated where listed.
Return the fully cooked lean back bacon to the pan and heat through.
Scatter over the 30g reduced-fat cheddar and let it melt over the hot filling.

Heat the sandwich toaster. Spoon the cooked filling between the measured bread slices, spreading it evenly and keeping wetter ingredients away from the edges. Do not overfill; serve any remaining cooked filling alongside.
Toast for around 4–6 minutes, following the appliance guidance, until the bread is crisp and the filling is steaming hot in the centre. Rest for one minute before cutting.
Serve the toastie with any remaining measured filling. Nutrition includes the whole portion, including the side.

review.notes: Plain wholemeal bread toasted crisp, bite-size cooked bacon, softened tomato, wilted spinach and cheddar; small side is remaining measured filling as method allows. No extra garnish.
review.alt: Bacon, tomato, spinach and cheddar toastie with remaining filling alongside.
